protocol.memoryDelete.purgeLimits: What can't be deleted: things {assistant} paraphrased in replies, messages {assistant} relayed to task and project maintainers, wait reasons {assistant} saw on the task board, paraphrases inside work orders given to project maintainers, your words that maintainers quoted and the runtime verified into plan-change cards, charter-change cards, operations-plan cards, stage acceptance records and charter change logs, plus assumption edits and watch categories you added when confirming a plan (they're part of the plan now). A copy also stays in backup snapshots until they rotate out (about 7 days on this machine, up to about 5 weeks in the sync folder).
protocol.memoryDelete.projectDeleteLimit: What can't be deleted: content read by calls that couldn't be traced to this project (paths built from environment variables, opaque commands like python -c), temp files saved when command output was too long (.log files starting with pi-bash), and anything {assistant} or other agents said based on it. A copy also stays in backup snapshots until they rotate out (about 7 days on this machine, up to about 5 weeks in the sync folder).
protocol.memoryDelete.forget.note: Removed from the material library; the original words still show in the chat history.
protocol.memoryDelete.purge.note: Deletes the original conversation too: the words in the event log and session files are replaced with a deletion marker, and attachments no other message uses are deleted. This can't be undone. {limits}
protocol.memoryDelete.noInfer.note: The material stays, but isn't used for inference.
